term: intrinsic state facts of a ground
definition: A ground's state at each world, with a fact for each state value that is true at a world exactly when the world has that state. A base of such facts lets the #742 core apply to state.
note: Stipulative. Reading the state as intrinsic to a ground is the analyst's; the structure only ties facts to values. See docs/notes/physical-ground-468.md.
